prompt.noi_dung: Progressive house, 124 bpm, A minor, euphoric festival energy. Warm supersaw chords with sidechain pump, bright plucked lead hook, deep sub bass, four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, snare-roll build-up into a big drop. Clear lead vocal singing in Vietnamese, airy backing vocals on the chorus, polished modern mix.
